svg.title: Threat model and the forgery chain
svg.desc: Four steps by which an attacker harvests a victim's request identifier and declares it as its own, alongside the capabilities the threat model grants and denies.
svg.text: A victim makes an ordinary request
authorised, legitimate, and not an attack
returned in the victim's own response body
It declares that value as its own
a shell prefix overrides what the application injected
trust boundary: everything above is untrusted
the identifier is live, so fail-closed never fires
No credential is stolen and no privilege is required. The identifier carries no tenant,
no principal and no authorisation state, so there is nothing in it to validate.
